__title: Flashcard box: you get quizzed on what you wrote · MyWorkLog
__metaDescription: The flashcard box quizzes you on what is in your report book and on what is still missing from your training framework. Short cards that come back before you forget them.
__ogTitle: You get quizzed on what you wrote.
__ogDescription: Cards from your report book that come back before you forget them.
kkTitel.abgefragt_wird_was_du_eingetrage: You get quizzed on what you wrote.
kkLede.kurze_karten_aus_deinem_berichtsh: Short cards from your report book and from what your training framework still lacks. What you didn’t know comes back before you forget it.
kkQuellenU.in_dieser_reihenfolge_die_ki: In this order. The AI doesn’t make up the topic, it is given one.
kkQ1P.was_du_eingetragen_hast_betrieb: What you wrote down, at work and at vocational school. That is revision.
kkQ2P.lernziele_deines_berufs_zu_denen: Learning goals of your occupation that your report book doesn’t mention yet. That is catching up.
kkA1T.es_merkt_sich_was_du: It remembers what you didn’t know
kkA1P.eine_falsche_karte_rutscht_zurueck: A wrong card slides back into the first box and comes back tomorrow. A right one moves further back until it only comes up once a month.
kkA2T.du_musst_nichts_fragen: You don’t have to ask anything
kkA2P.kein_eingabefeld_fuer_fragen_keine: No field for questions, no prompts. You open the box and today’s stack is already there.
kkA3T.jede_karte_sagt_woher_sie: Every card says where it comes from
kkA3P.unter_jeder_antwort_steht_die: Below every answer is its source: your week in the report book, the learning goal or your material. If something is wrong, you report the card with one tap.
kkVorschauP.der_kasten_selbst_funktionie: The box itself already works: boxes, intervals and quizzes run on your device. Cards from your report book, the training framework and your own material will be built by an AI later. Until the Training Pass launches, the preview is free. After that the flashcard box is part of the Pass, and it says so right now.
kkLeeren.kasten_auf_diesem_geraet_leeren: Empty the box on this device
kkStoff.zum_beispiel_deine_mitschrift_au: For example your notes from civics class
kkKastenCap.leer_leg_den_beispielstapel_: Empty. Add the sample deck to try it out.
kkQuellenT.die_karten_kommen_aus_deinem: The cards come from your report book, not from thin air.
kkQ3P.fuer_faecher_ohne_rahmenplan_text: For subjects without a framework: paste text or photograph your notebook page.
kkWiederT.was_du_nicht_wusstest_kommt: What you didn’t know comes back tomorrow.
kkWiederP.richtig_heisst_ein_fach_weiter: Right means one box further back. Wrong means back to the front. At the very back, a card only comes up once a month.
kkEndeT.du_machst_den_kasten_auf: You open the box. Today’s stack is already there.
kkEndeP.kein_eingabefeld_fuer_fragen_kei: No field for questions, no prompts, no chat.
kkStoffH.fuer_alles_was_in_keinem: For everything that isn’t in a training framework
kkStoffU.politik_deutsch_wirtschaft_fueg: Civics, German, economics: paste your notes or photograph the notebook page. They become cards for the same box.
